compute.cost_note: local and offline; Atom parsing plus HTML-to-text per post; no network

do_not_use_when: you only have the live blog URL (use acquire_blog)
you want the comment threads as the author's voice; comments are other people's prose and a different register

examples.cmd: python3 plugins/setec-voiceprint/scripts/acquire_blogger_takeout.py Takeout/ --persona author_slug --author "Author Name" --impostor-for my_persona --register blog_essay --consent-status author_consent --dry-run
examples.description: Dry-run a Takeout Blogger export before writing the impostor pool

inputs.target: Google Takeout Blogger directory or a single Blogger feed.atom file

purpose: import a Google Takeout Blogger export (a Takeout directory or a single feed.atom) offline into the private impostor pool, one cleaned .txt + .meta.json per post plus a draft manifest; comment feeds are skipped unless --include-comments.
use_when: the author shared a Google Takeout Blogger export and you want the full archive without scraping the public site
building a register-matched impostor pool from a Blogger blog you hold an export of
